21620.d: Rimmington is a small town located in the south-west part of Asgarnia, west of Port Sarim.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Free to play:
• Walk west from the Port Sarim lodestone or south from Falador.
• Use the explorer's ring 3 or 4 to teleport to the cabbage patch and walk south-west to get to Rimmington, but this takes longer.
• Use Remora's necklace from the Song from the Depths quest to teleport to the entrance of the Grotworm Lair.

Members:
• House Teleport and exit at Rimmington.
• If the Love Story quest has been completed, members can use a Rimmington tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to House tablet) to teleport to the Rimmington house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
• Teleport to the Crafting Guild with a skills necklace and then walk south-east.
• Use one of the free teleports of the Nature's sentinel outfit to teleport to the Elder trees up north.
• Travel to Crafting Guild via the skills necklace or balloon transport system and walk to the south.

21657.d: Ritual of the Mahjarrat is a grandmaster quest.

gt.heading: Travelling to Ghorrock
gt.text:
Travel to Ghorrock, the site on which the ritual will take place. It is recommended to travel by the canoe next to Erjolf in the Trollweiss Hunter area as this bypasses the Wilderness, for example by use of the Fremennik Province lodestone, the fairy ring code fairy ring | dks , or the Arctic bear familiar teleport.

Obtaining a Heat Globe

Go up the hill from the canoe to Ghorrock, pass the ice block on the western wall and enter the outer walls of the fortress, then enter the inner walls by the southern arch. The steel and iron dragons are non-aggressive, and shouldn't pose a problem for you if you don't accidentally click them. Climb up the western staircase and then back down on the east, scale up the damaged wall and finally climb back down the smashed rampart on the west (not the east ones) to reach the trapdoor to Ghorrock dungeon. There are far more icefiends and waterfiends than there were in the previous quests. (This is because the frostenhorn was taken, and with it the dungeon became more hostile.) These monsters prove dangerous to even high-level players due to sheer numbers and the quickness of their attacks. Run to the south-western corner and pick up the heat globe on the floor, and then run back and ascend the stairs.

Circle back around to exit the inner walls, and jump over the pillar immediately to the south. Enter the tunnel to the Ritual plateau.

g.label: Show on map
g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Ritual of the Mahjarrat', section 'Overview'

21658.d: Ritual plateau tunnels are a series of artificial tunnels located underneath Zemouregal's fort.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
One of the entrance to the tunnels is the cave entrance on the eastern side of Trollweiss Mountain. Another entrance is inside Zemouregal's fort.
• The quickest way to get there is to use either a Trollheim Teleport or a God Wars Dungeon Teleport. Follow the northwestern path, just west of the boulder that leads to the God Wars Dungeon. Then go through the troll tunnels past some aggressive ice trolls to the top of Trollweiss Mountain, and head straight east to reach the tunnels.
• After partial completion of the quest Ritual of the Mahjarrat, players can use fairy ring DKQ to teleport to the Glacor Cave. Exit the cave and then head to the west to Zemouregal's fort. Open the main entrance and then open the door on the east side. Climb down the stairs to reach the tunnels.

21729.d: The rock (hidey-hole) is a hidey-hole located inside the celestial dragon resource dungeon on Dragontooth Island.
